notes.content:
Changelog

Spawn system:
- Increased AI spawn protection radius from 600 to 1200
- Updated spawn points on Depot
- Updated spawn points on Village
- Updated spawn points on Storm
- Updated spawn points on Crosspoint
- Respawn text now showing the key to press
- Increased AI respawn time

Weapons:
- Increased K&H M7 recoil and spread
- Reduced K&H M7 magazine size from 40 to 30
- Reduced K&H M7 ammo capacity from 120 to 90
- Decreased AR47 accuracy
- Increased Baratta M9 damage
- Updated MX8 sight
- Increased MX8 recoil

Other:
- Fixed broken achievements
- Fixed issue with AI not playing footstep sounds
- Fixed missing texture on Depot
- Fixed scoreboard rank misplaced on higher ranks
